title: Climbing Stairs
statement: Start at ground level. Each move climbs one or two steps. Count the distinct move sequences that land exactly on step n.

examples.explanation: Only a single one-step move works.
The count is the sum of the 5 routes to step 4 and the 3 routes to step 3.

hints: Conceptual: Look at the final move in a valid sequence.
Directional: Every sequence ends with a move from step n−1 or n−2.
Implementation: Add the counts for the previous two steps and keep only those two counts while iterating.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
